description: Angular component class for AI configuration within a rule node, including form setup, validation, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: AiConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring AI-related rule node settings, including form controls, validation, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for AI configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables schema validation based on response format type.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and trims the configuration object for output.

methods.name: onEntityChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the selected AI model entity, adjusting response format accordingly.

methods.name: getResponseFormatHint
methods.description: Provides a localized hint message for the response format.

methods.name: createModelAi
methods.description: Opens a dialog to create or select an AI model and updates the form with the selected model ID.

methods.name: createAiResources
methods.description: Opens a dialog to create or select AI resources and updates the form with resource IDs.
